new_findings.title: LastPipe class XML describes the outer filter invocation as an unconditional no-op
Typed message Send/Publish pipe XML incorrectly promises context conversion and misnames its generic parameter
Consume observer converter XML incorrectly promises publish/connection operations instead of supplied observer callbacks
Serialized durable send XML incorrectly promises immutable retained memory views
Message entity name XML misstates success-only cache and post-cache equal-name setter policy
